title: LichenFrame serializer emits reserved MIC selectors
description: Security validation finding in python/src/lichen/link/frame.py: LichenFrame._validate never requires mic_length to be a valid MicLength enum. Supplying runtime value 2..7 (or another int) reaches llsec_byte(), is masked into bits 2-4, and to_bytes emits a wire frame that this same implementation obligatorily rejects as reserved in from_bytes. Require an exact supported MicLength at serialization and add invalid integer/bool/object boundary tests so local callers and vector tools cannot generate profile-invalid security headers.
